purpose: First individual animal lifecycle: feeding, metabolism, moisture response, parthenogenetic reproduction, genealogy and death-to-detritus. Not yet a validated population model.

temperatureOptimumC.notes: Around 21 C is reported as a reproductive optimum in the cited life-history context; used as the development-response center.

eggDevelopmentDays.notes: Eggs hatch in approximately 10 days at 20 C.

adultDevelopmentDays.notes: Placed inside the reported ~21-24 day first-oviposition window; represents reproductive maturity rather than a universal anatomical threshold.

reproductionIntervalDays.notes: Initial interval representing roughly weekly subsequent oviposition; subject to age-dependent refinement later.

clutchSize.notes: Engineering starting value to be calibrated against 28-day reproduction output distributions.

adultLifespanDays.notes: Longevity is strongly temperature-dependent; this is deliberately provisional at ~20-21 C.

feedingCarbonRateMgPerSecond.notes: No direct species-specific fungal carbon ingestion rate has yet been frozen.

reserveTargetFraction.notes: Controls hunger onset; not a measured lipid fraction.

reproductionReserveFraction.notes: Minimum carbon reserve fraction required before egg production.

basalMetabolismCarbonMgPerSecond.notes: Initial individual metabolic carbon loss; must be sensitivity-tested.

starvationDeathDays.notes: Time with effectively exhausted reserves before starvation death.

moistureHalfSaturationWaterG.notes: Maps world substrate-water mass to a dimensionless suitability proxy; not a direct RH conversion.

reproductionMoistureThreshold.notes: Represents the strong moisture sensitivity of reproduction, while keeping the world-model proxy explicit.

desiccationRatePerSecond.notes: Fractional body-water loss under unsuitable moisture.

hydrationRatePerSecond.notes: Proxy for rapid water-balance restoration in highly humid substrate.

adultDryMassMg.notes: Approximate dry mass of medium-sized 25 ± 3 day adults in the cited culture.

adultCarbonMg.notes: Assumes carbon is ~45% of adult dry mass; conversion is not species-specific.

adultBodyWaterG.notes: Order-of-magnitude body-water target assembled from reported dry/fresh-mass studies; not a frozen species constant.

initialJuvenileCarbonMg.notes: 12-day juvenile starting carbon below adult anchor.

eggCarbonMg.notes: Egg material allocation; must be fitted to fecundity/body-mass constraints.
